model-new-book.code:
model NewBook
  @minLength(1) title: string
  author: string
  year: int

model-book-changes.code:
model BookChanges
  title?: string
  year?: int
  available?: boolean

entity-loan.code:
@entity("loans")
entity Loan
  @primary(generated = true)
  id: int
  bookId: int
  reader: string
  returned: boolean = false

repo-by-author.code:
repository BookRepository
  byAuthor(author: string) Book[]
    where({ "author": author })
    orderBy("year")
    getMany()

repo-available-since.code:
repository BookRepository
  availableSince(year: int, max: int = 20) Book[]
    where({ "available": true, "year": { "gte": year } })
    orderBy("title")
    limit(max)
    getMany()

repo-by-title.code:
repository BookRepository
  byTitle(title: string) Result<Error, Book>
    where({ "title": title })
    getOne()

repo-count-open-loans.code:
repository LoanRepository
  openFor(reader: string) int
    where({ "reader": reader, "returned": false })
    count()

usecase-create-book.code:
usecase CreateBook(books: BookRepository)
  exec(input: NewBook) Result<Error, Book>
    existing = ~books.findAll()
    for b in existing
      if b.title == input.title
        return Err(Conflict("A book titled '${input.title}' already exists"))
    saved = ~books.save(Book(title = input.title, author = input.author, year = input.year))
    Ok(saved)

usecase-get-book.code:
usecase GetBook(books: BookRepository)
  exec(id: int) Result<Error, Book>
    ~books.find(id)

usecase-lend-book.code:
usecase LendBook(books: BookRepository, loans: LoanRepository)
  @transactional
  exec(bookId: int, reader: string) Result<Error, Loan>
    book = ~books.find(bookId)
    if not book.available
      return Err(Conflict("Book ${bookId} is not available"))
    book.available = false
    ~books.save(book)
    loan = ~loans.save(Loan(bookId = bookId, reader = reader))
    Ok(loan)

usecase-books-of-author.code:
usecase BooksOfAuthor(books: BookRepository)
  exec(author: string) Result<Error, Book[]>
    if author.length == 0
      Err(Invalid("author is empty"))
    else
      Ok(~books.byAuthor(author))

appcomponent-books.code:
appcomponent BooksAppComponent
  book() = GetBook.exec
  create() = CreateBook.exec
  byAuthor() = BooksOfAuthor.exec

appcomponent-loans.code:
appcomponent LoansAppComponent
  lend() = LendBook.exec
  giveBack() = ReturnBook.exec

tools-books.code:
tools BookTools(books: BooksAppComponent)
  // Gives the title of the book with that id.
  bookTitle(id: int) string
    match ~books.book(id)
      Ok(b) -> b.title
      Err(e) -> e.message

tools-loans.code:
tools LoanTools(loans: LoansAppComponent)
  // Lends a book to a reader.
  lend(bookId: int, reader: string) string
    match ~loans.lend(bookId, reader)
      Ok(l) -> "loan ${l.id}"
      Err(e) -> e.message

agent-loans.code:
agent LoanDesk(tools: LoanTools)
  model: string = "coder"
  prompt: string = "You lend books. Confirm every loan."

tests-create-book.code:
tests Books
  books: BooksAppComponent = inject<BooksAppComponent>()

  @test("creates a book and refuses the same title")
  checkDuplicate()
    book = NewBook(title = "Dune", author = "Herbert", year = 1965)
    first = ~books.create(book)
    expect(first.isOk)
    second = ~books.create(book)
    expect(second.error.status == 409)

tests-missing-book.code:
tests Missing
  @test("a missing book is 404")
  missingBook()
    app = inject<BooksAppComponent>()
    result = ~app.book(999)
    match result
      Err(e) -> expect(e.status == 404)
      Ok(_) -> expect(false)

service-isbn.code:
// Validates ISBN-13 codes by length only.
service Isbn
  valid(code: string) boolean
    code.replace("-", "").length == 13

function-label.code:
// Classifies a book by its age.
service Labels
  age(year: int, now: int) string
    if now - year < 2
      "new"
    else if now - year < 10
      "recent"
    else
      "classic"
